name: error-recovery
prompt: Run: python3 -c "from buggy import load; print(load('data.csv'))". It fails because data.csv contains a non-integer value. Fix the program so that bad rows are SKIPPED (with a warning printed to stderr) instead of crashing, and valid rows still load. Then run the command again — it must print {'apple': 10, 'pear': 20} (with possibly a warning line before it).

assert.cmd: python3 -c "from buggy import load; d=load('data.csv'); assert d=={'apple':10,'pear':20}, d"
